verdict.rationale: Polar documents an official remote MCP server with production and sandbox endpoints and OAuth-based authorization. Agents can look up data and take actions across products, customers, subscriptions, orders and benefits, and setup instructions cover Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT and Claude Desktop. A probe confirms the MCP documentation page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agent connections and actions work in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Use Polar's remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) server to give AI agents secure access to your Polar organization.
Agents can look up data and take actions across your products, customers, subscriptions, orders, benefits, and more.
Polar MCP uses OAuth. When you connect a client, your browser opens so you can sign in and authorize access to your organization.
official MCP server documented at https://polar.sh/docs/integrate/mcp
